facts.business: Kakatiya Textiles Ltd is engaged in the textile business involving sale and purchase of goods and job work charges with related parties.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with SVR Spinning Mills Private Limited and Ravali Spinners Private Limited include sale of goods (Rs 33.74 lakhs and Rs 1866.40 lakhs), purchase of goods (Rs 347.73 lakhs and Rs 1575.36 lakhs), and job work charges (Rs 87.70 lakhs) during the year, all at arm's length basis and approved by the Board on 29.05.2025.
